description: This file contains shell functions for managing platform-specific upgrade procedures in an embedded Linux environment. It includes functions for checking image compatibility, copying configuration data, and performing upgrades by manipulating disk partitions and image data.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the image partition layout matches the current disk layout before upgrading.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to a designated partition during upgrade.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the main upgrade procedure, including partition comparison, image writing, and partition UUID updates.
